study type: Quasi-experimental interventional study with historical and subsequent controls
cohort: The study involved 19 infants born at <25 weeks gestation who received the intervention, compared to 20 historical controls and 20 subsequent controls.
finding: Oropharyngeal surfactant with simultaneous SIM was feasible and safe and significantly reduced the need for delivery room intubation in extremely premature infants born at <25 weeks gestation.
followup_time: Up to severe neonatal morbidity and death; specific duration not mentioned.
